1.title: AI Makes 25% of Workers Less Productive | Russ Fradin
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Larridin CEO Russ Fradin presents enterprise AI research showing AI productivity gains concentrate on top performers while bottom 25% see reduced output; breaks down why agent adoption remains <5%, how companies must audit workflows to justify AI spend, and when labor displacement actually hits.

1.title: Autonomous Software Factories Arrive by 2031 | Luke Alvoeiro
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Luke Alvoeiro presents Droid 1.0, a programmatic tool-calling engine that reduces context bloat in agent chains; covers Terminal Bench 4 results (8% lead over Claude Code), safeguards for multi-step script generation, and a 5-year outlook on autonomous software factories.

2.title: This New Grok Bot Feature Just Saved Me $500 a Year (Seriously)
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: Peter Yang demonstrates Grok's voice-calling feature negotiating a real Comcast bill reduction ($84→$45/month), covers 5 use cases for delegating calls, setup walkthrough, and compares Grok vs Muse for AI phone calls.

1.title: Emily D. Baker on the power of Live Streaming & Memberships
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube product manager and creator liaison discuss live streaming mechanics, membership monetization, member perks (ad-free viewing, chat slowmode bypass), new features (Watch With reactions, Go Live matchmaking), and mobile @ mentions. Practical advice on starting live streams and building real-time community.

2.title: Robots Will Proliferate Daily Life in 5 Years | Josh Gruenstein
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Tutor Intelligence CEO on $75M Series B for warehouse robotics, foundation models (GPT-4o) enabling physical automation, and why 90% of US warehouses still lack robots. Discusses CAISI/Sunny robots, real-world data flywheel, and deflation of physical goods through low-cost robotic labor.

1.title: Social Media Will Sever Chat From Content
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Social platforms are shifting away from personal chat toward AI-generated vertical video and long-form content; traditional home gatherings are being replaced by commercial IRL spaces (run clubs, supper clubs) as a destination for social time.
